title: Cloud Control Plane API Call Volume Anomaly (MLTK)

controlTest.positiveScenario: Replay sample `aws:cloudtrail` events with `sourcetype IN ("aws:cloudtrail","azure:monitor:activity","google:gcp:pubsub:message")` into `index=cloud`. Confirm UC-4.4.32 returns >=1 row and the alert fires.
controlTest.negativeScenario: Replay benign `aws:cloudtrail` traffic without `sourcetype IN ("aws:cloudtrail","azure:monitor:activity","google:gcp:pubsub:message")`. Confirm UC-4.4.32 returns zero rows and the alert does not fire.

dataSources: `index=cloud` sourcetype=`aws:cloudtrail` collected via Splunk Machine Learning Toolkit (MLTK), Splunk Add-on for AWS / Azure / GCP; validate ingest with `| stats count by sourcetype`.
app: Splunk Machine Learning Toolkit (MLTK), Splunk Add-on for AWS / Azure / GCP

description: UC-4.4.32 — Cloud Control Plane API Call Volume Anomaly (MLTK): queries multi-cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP) `aws:cloudtrail` for search criteria `sourcetype IN ("aws:cloudtrail","azure:monitor:activity","google:gcp:pubsub:message")` and returns actor, resource, and region context for security review and change validation.
value: On multi-cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), detecting 'Cloud Control Plane API Call Volume Anomaly (MLTK)' early shortens cloud incident response and produces defensible audit evidence for identity and change-management controls. UC-4.4.32 drives critical-priority security alerting before customer-impacting drift.
implementation: Aggregate CloudTrail / Activity Log / Admin Activity events hourly by API action and principal. Train DensityFunction models per API action on 30 days of data to capture automation schedules and deployment patterns. Flag calls that exceed 3 standard deviations from the learned baseline. Prioritize high-risk APIs: IAM mutations, security group changes, KMS key operations, and resource creation. Enrich with source IP geolocation and threat intelligence. Correlate with CI/CD deployment events (cat-12) to suppress planned automation bursts. Generate risk events for Splunk ES with MITRE T1078/T1580 annotations. Retrain models weekly.
visualization: Line chart (API call volume vs baseline), Table (anomalous API calls with z-scores), Bar chart (top anomalous APIs by principal).

dataModelAcceleration: Enable data model acceleration for Change (All_Changes).
knownFalsePositives: This pattern can surge during change windows, in sandboxes, and when a platform is in maintenance, so we line alerts up with the calendar and take a second look before we call it an incident.
detailedImplementation:
Prerequisites
• Splunk Enterprise or Splunk Cloud with search access to `index=cloud`.
• Install and configure Splunk Machine Learning Toolkit (MLTK), Splunk Add-on for AWS / Azure / GCP with the modular input for `aws:cloudtrail`.
• Prerequisite crawl UC(s): UC-4.4.33.
• Confirm field extractions in `props.conf` for `userIdentity.arn` and related actor fields.

Step 1 — Configure data collection
Aggregate CloudTrail / Activity Log / Admin Activity events hourly by API action and principal. Train DensityFunction models per API action on 30 days of data to capture automation schedules and deployment patterns. Flag calls that exceed 3 standard deviations from the learned baseline. Prioritize high-risk APIs: IAM mutations, security group changes, KMS key operations, and resource creation. Enrich with source IP geolocation and threat intelligence. Correlate with CI/CD deployment events (cat-12) to suppress planned automation bursts. Generate risk events for Splunk ES with MITRE T1078/T1580 annotations. Retrain models weekly.
Validate ingest before alerting:
```spl
index=cloud sourcetype="aws:cloudtrail" | stats count by sourcetype
```

Step 2 — Create the search and alert
```spl
index=cloud sourcetype="aws:cloudtrail" sourcetype IN ("aws:cloudtrail","azure:monitor:activity","google:gcp:pubsub:message")
| table _time userIdentity.arn eventName sourceIPAddress awsRegion
| eval uc_marker="UC-4.4.32_cloud_control_plane_api_32"
| sort -_time
```

Understanding this SPL
Scopes `aws:cloudtrail` in `index=cloud` to detect cloud control plane api call volume anomaly (mltk). Tune thresholds to your change cadence; exclude break-glass principals and sandbox accounts via a lookup.

Step 3 — Validate
Compare to the AWS CloudTrail console Event history for the same 24-hour window. Confirm row counts and `userIdentity.arn` values match the vendor console. Run `| fieldsummary` on a 1-hour sample to verify extractions.

Step 4 — Operationalize and troubleshoot
Save as `4_4_32_alert` with severity aligned to `critical` criticality. Dashboard: Line chart (API call volume vs baseline), Table (anomalous API calls with z-scores), Bar chart (top anomalous APIs by principal)..
Failure modes: (1) no events — verify modular input/API credentials and index routing; (2) empty actor fields — upgrade Splunk Machine Learning Toolkit (MLTK), Splunk Add-on for AWS / Azure / GCP and review alias mappings; (3) API throttling — reduce poll frequency or enable queue buffering; (4) alert fatigue — tune thresholds and document exclusions in knownFalsePositives.
